unit.description: One unit = 15 BPMN + 5 DMN + 10 DRL plus supporting assets. Tiers are whole multiples of the unit so the archetype/exception mix is identical in proportion.

derived_support.wid: one WorkDefinitions.wid per domain that owns at least one handler
derived_support.config: fixed per project: pom.xml, kmodule.xml, kie-deployment-descriptor.xml, persistence.xml, project.imports, project.repositories, package-names-white-list

exceptions.javascript-script: first script process: Script Task uses the JavaScript script format (rule 3)
exceptions.drools-gateway-dialect: first gateway process: one sequence-flow condition uses the DROOLS dialect (rule 4)
exceptions.dotted-hyphenated-process-id: third human-task process: process id contains dots and hyphens and is the call target of a subprocess (rule 6)
exceptions.shared-session-insert: DRL referenced by the first rule-task: RHS calls insert() across the BPMN/DRL boundary (rule 5)
exceptions.dmn-1-1-namespace: fifth DMN: authored against the DMN 1.1 namespace

expected_dispositions.migrate: asset must be present in v9 output under the same identity
expected_dispositions.migrate-with-update: asset must be present in v9 output (identity may be remapped via dispositions.json) after a required v9 change
expected_dispositions.replace: v8 construct has no direct v9 equivalent; requires a traceable v9 replacement or a documented manual disposition
expected_dispositions.regenerate: form must be regenerated via Developer Tools, or recorded as a documented manual follow-up
expected_dispositions.remove: v8-only file that must be absent from v9 output
